vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ernie-image-visual-promptsmith
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is a well-structured tool for generating images via the Baidu AI Studio ERNIE-Image API. The bundled Python script (scripts/generate.py) uses standard libraries to communicate with the official Baidu endpoint and handle image downloads/saving, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or obfuscation. The documentation and agent instructions in SKILL.md and the references directory are strictly focused on prompt engineering and API usage, aligning perfectly with the stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill's code, requirements, and instructions are consistent with its stated purpose of crafting ERNIE-Image prompts and calling Baidu AI Studio; nothing requests unrelated credentials or installs arbitrary code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the actual behavior: the skill uses a bundled Python script to call the Baidu AI Studio ERNIE-Image endpoint and save returned images. Declared requirements (python and BAIDU_AISTUDIO_API_KEY) are proportionate and expected for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines runtime actions to building prompts, running the bundled script, and returning URLs/paths. It does not instruct the agent to read unrelated system files or other credentials. The script sends prompts to the Baidu endpoint and downloads images — behavior described in the documentation and consistent with the skill purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with a bundled Python script and no install spec. No network-installed third-party packages or remote archives are fetched during install; runtime uses standard Python stdlib HTTP calls, which is proportionate.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only BAIDU_AISTUDIO_API_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential. No unrelated secrets or system config paths are requested. The key is legitimately needed to call the Baidu API.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false, no special persistent privileges are requested, and the skill does not modify other skills or system-wide configuration. It writes generated images to a user-specified output directory (expected behavior).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill will send your prompts (including any exact visible text you include) and your BAIDU_AISTUDIO_API_KEY to Baidu AI Studio. Only provide an API key you trust to be used with external services. Avoid embedding sensitive data in prompts. Be aware generated images and prompts may be logged or retained by the provider per their policies. The skill saves images locally — check file paths and permissions if that matters. Finally, verify you are comfortable with Baidu's terms and any content/licensing implications for generated images before use.
